newsitem.title: MEXICO: ICA-led group wins Mexican storage site.
newsitem.headline: ICA-led group wins Mexican storage site.

text.p: Mexican builder Empresas ICA and Internacional de Contenedores Asociados de Veracruz won the bidding to obtain the capital of storage warehouse Almacenadora Sur (ALSUR), the Finance Ministry said on Monday in a statement.
The ministry did not detail the winning bid.
The ICA-led group beat out a competing consortium led by Mexican grain company Grupo Minsa.

Mexico's Federal Competition Commission had ruled out the participation of Grupo Servia, composed of shipping giantTransportacion Maritima Mexicana (TMM), Louis Dreyfus Corporation, Societe Generale, Inversora del Sureste, Vitrocontrol and Moltrim.
The storage facility is one of three companies created in the privatization of the nation's warehouses. Also to be auctioned are northern and western sites.
Alsur receives grains from the Veracruz Grain Terminal and the Miguel Alerman silos in the state of Mexico, and is an important source of the nation's staple corn.
